Sandbox_WHSaveTrim_Enabled_tooltip: On: Wandering Hordes' wall map (WH_PassabilityGrid_v2 in global_mod_data.bin) is kept only around the players, so the world save and the server start stay fast. Off: the map grows with every tile anybody visits, as without this add-on. Applies at once, also when an admin changes it in a running game.
Sandbox_WHSaveTrim_KeepRadius_tooltip: The wall map is kept within this many tiles (a square) of every player, join spot, offline spot and safehouse; the rest is removed. 400 covers everything Wandering Hordes checks when a horde appears near a player (up to 75 + 300 tiles). Smaller = smaller save, but a fenced area farther away is scanned again only when a player comes near it.
Sandbox_WHSaveTrim_KeepJoinSpots_tooltip: Also keep the map around the spot where each player came into the game (usually the base he logged out at), also while he is away on a long trip, so the fences of the base are still known when he comes back. Server: remembered for 30 days; single player: the spot where the game was loaded.
Sandbox_WHSaveTrim_KeepOfflinePlayers_to: Also keep the map around the spot where each player was last seen (for 30 days), so his surroundings are still known when he logs in again. Multiplayer server only.
Sandbox_WHSaveTrim_KeepSafehouses_toolti: Also keep the map around every safehouse, so the fences of a base are remembered while everybody is away.
Sandbox_WHSaveTrim_IntervalMinutes_toolt: How often the map is checked (real minutes). A check costs well under a millisecond per tick for a few seconds; the first one on a big old save takes longer.
Sandbox_WHSaveTrim_Log_tooltip: Writes a line for every check to console.txt ([WHSaveTrim] lines): how much was removed and kept. The first check that removes something is always logged. For bug reports.
